title: Establish a ten-minute feasibility preflight with a concrete contradiction witness

parentBehavior.description: Admit only capability-supported slices and turn unknown or contradictory prerequisites into one bounded discovery/design prerequisite.

problem: Supervisor and Project Lead slicing has no short, explicit map from a criterion to the capability, permitted change, dependency, owner, and witness that would prove it. The known LocalAI artifact mismatch can therefore consume a full dispatch before it is reported.
outcome: A reviewer can classify feasible, unknown, and contradictory criteria within a ten-minute no-build preflight, derive a stable discovery-prerequisite identity, detect an equivalent accepted/nonterminal Work before submission, and preserve the LocalAI failure lineage without retry or duplication.
sourcePlanRef: factory/docs/operating-policy.md#project-contract-and-autonomy-boundaries; #work-shaping-and-throughput; #failure-classification-and-escalation; requirement: unknown capability yields one short discovery/design prerequisite
actorAndTrigger: The Portfolio Supervisor or Project Lead runs the check before admitting an implementation slice or allowing a planner to begin a broad investigation.
sharedSurfaceOwnership: T001 owns the preflight vocabulary and identity rule. T002 consumes it and must not define a conflicting capability or prerequisite identity. Luna owns this design surface. The LocalAI lead owns immutable LocalAI evidence and LA-05/LA-06 only.

in: Exact Models and Workers symbols and the LocalAI contradiction
Feasible, unknown, contradictory, and no-approval outcomes
Active Work and stable request-identity checks
out: Production admission code or test changes
Generated/API files, live settings, provider/model calls, and operator approval for routine design

constraints: Use Factory, Factory Session, Work, and Worker Session vocabulary; keep Petri-net mechanics private.
Read one selected public session and only directly cited symbols; do not build, download, call a provider/model, run broad tests, or perform an architecture survey during preflight.
Factory Work and Factory Events remain authoritative; docs/temp is not a queue or identity store.
The LocalAI Project contract, failed lineage, corrective lineage, and recovery Work remain immutable read-only inputs.
Routine design uses ordinary delivery/review; do not invent HUMAN_APPROVAL without a real authority, immutable-contract, safety, or budget decision.

contractChanges.current: # Not present: no authored bounded-feasibility result shape.
contractChanges.proposed: # Design-only handoff shape; no API, generated file, or runtime writer is authorized by T001.

preflight.measurement: Monotonic stopwatch from first criterion read to the bounded result; timeout returns BLOCKED and never authorizes further investigation.
prohibited: Live Work, Factory, or settings mutation

timebox.action: Read immutable Project, criterion, contract revision, and permitted scope.
Inspect the one directly named public capability or file/symbol.
timebox.stop: Missing capability is recorded as DISCOVERY_REQUIRED.

timebox.action: Map permitted change, semantic dependency, owner, and witness.
timebox.stop: An immutable-contract or authority conflict returns CONTRADICTION.

timebox.action: Normalize identity inputs and compute the candidate request ID.
Read public Work/Event state for an equivalent accepted/nonterminal prerequisite or corrective Work.
timebox.stop: A match returns ALREADY_ADMITTED; failed history remains evidence only.
Elapsed time never becomes a retry signal.

timebox.action: Record owner, witness, exit condition, identity, and no-action/request fields, then stop.
timebox.stop: No additional source or runtime investigation is allowed.

inputMap.evidence: One named public operation or file/symbol
Public Work/Event/Worker Session facts or source-plan requirement
Public read, controlled observation, named symbol, or later gate

decisionVocabulary.condition: Every capability has direct evidence, the change is permitted, dependencies have owners, and a witness is named.
decisionVocabulary.action: Continue ordinary bounded design/delivery; no operator-approval gate.

decisionVocabulary.condition: A required capability is unknown or cannot be mapped within the timebox.
decisionVocabulary.action: Return one prerequisite with owner, dependency, witness, smallest exit condition, and stable identity; admit no implementation and retry nothing.

decisionVocabulary.condition: A visible capability shape cannot satisfy the criterion under the permitted change or immutable contract.
decisionVocabulary.action: Name both shapes and the allowed-change boundary; preserve Work/history and submit nothing.

decisionVocabulary.condition: A public Work/Event read finds the same stable prerequisite or corrective identity already accepted and nonterminal.
decisionVocabulary.action: Submit no new Work Request and retry no failed Work.

decisionVocabulary.condition: A public read or identity cannot be trusted, or the timebox expires.
decisionVocabulary.action: Return a structured blocker with owner and observable exit; perform no guessed mutation.

stableIdentity.normalization: Trim whitespace, lowercase ASCII identifiers, and reject empty project, criterionId, contractRevision, or capabilityKey.
matching: Read public Work including superseded history as applicable and the canonical Factory Event stream.
Match request ID first, then the normalized tuple in Work/Event correlation.
INITIAL or PROCESSING equivalent is ALREADY_ADMITTED.
FAILED Work or a failed historical event is causal evidence, not an active duplicate.
A new contract revision or causal capability may produce a new identity only after the owner records genuinely new evidence.
stableIdentity.lostResponse: Reuse the same identity on the next public reread; never create a second identity.

localaiWitness.requiredCapability: Artifact-bearing generic inference output with Work artifact identity and size-or-digest lineage

symbols.currentCapability: Detached response has Text and Usage only.
symbols.gap: No artifact reference, size, or digest is available at this protocol boundary.

symbols.currentCapability: Predict is called, response.Text is required, text InferenceContent is returned, and optional usage is retained when declared.
symbols.gap: The pinned OMNI path does not construct an artifact-bearing output.

symbols.currentCapability: OMNI requests route to runtime.omni.Invoke; only non-OMNI fallthrough reaches the generic runtime.
symbols.gap: The artifact-capable generic fallback does not repair the OMNI response shape.

symbols.currentCapability: WorkContentPart.ArtifactID and metadata are assigned only when InferenceOutput.Artifact is non-nil and non-zero.
symbols.gap: Text/usage alone cannot prove the immutable Work artifact identity/size-or-digest lineage.

event.failure: The required artifact identity/size-or-digest lineage is not available from the Text/Usage OMNI path.

publicWorkLineage.role: existing nonterminal authority-retry lineage; do not duplicate

result.allowedExit: one discovery/design prerequisite; no LocalAI Project, active Work, or production contract mutation
result.owner: Luna for the design packet; LocalAI Project lead for the immutable artifact contract and LA-05/LA-06
result.witness: Factory Event dispatch-completed feedback plus the cited Models/Workers symbols

tabletop.given: A required capability has no bounded public operation or directly cited symbol.
tabletop.then: Return DISCOVERY_REQUIRED with missing capability, owner, dependency, witness, smallest exit condition, and stable identity; submit no implementation Work and retry nothing.
tabletop.observer: Controlled result fields and public request count

tabletop.given: The LocalAI criterion requires InferenceOutput.Artifact, InvocationProtocolResponse exposes only Text/Usage, and localai-project-v1 cannot be amended by this slice.
tabletop.then: Return CONTRADICTION naming the exact symbols and allowed-change boundary, recognize existing corrective/recovery lineage, submit no duplicate Work Request, and retry no failed Work.
tabletop.observer: Decision, existing Work IDs, event identity, and no-action fields

tabletop.given: A routine criterion is covered by existing public Work, Factory Event, and Worker Session read controls and has a permitted design change.
tabletop.when: The preflight evaluates the bounded slice.
tabletop.then: Return ADMIT_BOUNDED_SLICE with capability, permitted change, dependency, owner, and witness; add no HUMAN_APPROVAL or operator-approval Work.
tabletop.observer: Complete capability map and absence of approval request

tabletop.given: Routine design has no authority, budget, safety, or immutable-contract decision.
tabletop.when: The supervisor/lead submits the design path through ordinary delivery/review.
tabletop.then: Continue autonomously; escalate only when a real authority or contract decision appears.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Given the LocalAI fixture, the walkthrough reports the exact Text/Usage versus InferenceOutput.Artifact contradiction within ten minutes, names the allowed discovery/design exit, and creates no retry or duplicate corrective Work.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The design contract, exact symbol map, public event/Work/Worker Session witness, stable identity, and M-02 tabletop record the contradiction and no-action outcome.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Given an existing-capability criterion, the walkthrough returns a complete capability/witness map and no invented operator approval gate.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: M-03 and M-18 define the public read capability, permitted design change, dependency, owner, witness, ADMIT_BOUNDED_SLICE result, and no-approval rule.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Given an active equivalent prerequisite or corrective Work, the identity check reports already-admitted and submits no new Work Request.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The identity algorithm matches stable request IDs/tuples against public Work/Event state, distinguishes active nonterminal Work from failed history, and records the existing LocalAI authority-retry/recovery lineage without a new request.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Given an unmappable capability, preflight stops with a structured prerequisite carrying an owner and observable exit rather than an implementation-ready claim.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: DISCOVERY_REQUIRED and BLOCKED define the owner, dependency, witness, smallest exit condition, hard stop, and fail-closed behavior; M-01 exercises the unmappable case.

verification.behavioralWitness: Independent reviewer walks M-01, M-02, M-03, and M-18 with the exact LocalAI fixture and records decision, capability map, identity, owner, witness, and no-action/request outcome.

evidence.doesNotProve: Future preflight runtime code or real LocalAI inference.

evidence.procedure: One reviewer tabletop of M-01, M-02, M-03, and M-18 with a ten-minute stopwatch and no writes.
evidence.artifact: This task packet's preflight decision table and stable identity rule.
evidence.proves: Deterministic classification, stable prerequisite identity, and no invented approval/no-retry boundary.

verification.highestFeasibleLevel: Functional design review combining local public evidence and controlled tabletop; production runtime is out of scope.

remainingUnprovenEdges.edge: Preflight implementation and public admission behavior

verification.testDesign: No tests change in T001. Future pure classification branches use POLICY-UNIT with explicit fake public responses, fresh values per case, no root process, no sleeps, and no source-scanning meta-tests. Public admission behavior uses the prebuilt PUBLIC-REPLAY lane.

paidValidation.trigger: None; customer budget prohibits new provider/model validation.
paidValidation.fixture: Sanitized local public reads and controlled tabletop.

operationalAndRollout.retryPolicy: Known contradiction, failed Work, and elapsed timer never authorize retry.
operationalAndRollout.rollback: No runtime rollout exists in T001. Preserve event history and Work; any future change stops and returns a reviewed delta on duplicate, stale, malformed, or unreadable identity.
operationalAndRollout.futureOwner: Supervisor controls future admission/canary; LocalAI lead owns immutable LocalAI contract evidence; T002 owns incident semantics.
